title: Genomic Landscape of Metastatic Urothelial Cancer in a Multicenter Cohort From Argentina.
snippet: The genomic landscape of advanced urothelial carcinoma (aUC) has enabled the development of targeted therapies; however, real-world data from Latin America remain limited. title: ITHindex: An integrated web-based platform for intratumor heterogeneity evaluation.
snippet: Intratumor heterogeneity (ITH) is a critical factor influencing cancer progression, therapeutic response, and the development of drug resistance. Despite its importance, the lack of a definitive gold standard for ITH quantification has hindered consistent clinical application.
